manifest_not_yet_created: the manifest is written when mature_count first reaches 20,000; only the rule is frozen now
why_tie_breakers: around the 20,000th episode several will complete maturity on the same session. Without a declared ordering, which one is #20,000 becomes a choice made at the moment it matters.
locked_set: the first 20,000 rows under the frozen ordering
excluded: episode 20,001 onward is not in the validation run, whatever it looks like
lock_hash: sha256 over the ordered episode_id list plus the four hashes above
after_lock: max-Z correction over eligible members only
one_deterministic_run: the input manifest hash is known before the test is run
